wiring_rule_reference: 10_PLAN_COMMAND_WIRING_DRY_IMPACT.md: ui_source -> command -> canonical_owner -> validation_permission -> state/op -> event/receipt/ObservableWork -> ui_projection -> usage/diagnostic -> recovery/deep_link
note: Provisional candidate wiring traces only. No concept-only local state may masquerade as production wiring. Each trace names the canonical owner, command, validation, op, event/receipt, projection, attribution, and recovery.

traces.distinguishes: one-shot action vs scheduled-backup SETTING vs last-backup STATUS vs manager vs log; must NOT mutate the schedule setting

steps.1_ui_source: Backup & Restore landmark -> Back Up Now button (domain_action), distinct from the schedule toggle (setting) and last-backup badge (status)
steps.3_canonical_owner: Plans/storage-plan.md (backup/restore/compaction owner); Settings Lifecycle owner is NOT involved
steps.4_validation_permission: permission gate backup.write; validate scope is one of settings/project/server; reject if legal_hold_conflict for destructive scopes; ResourceGovernor admission
steps.5_state_op: acquire aggregate canonical-store lock (storage-plan.md:1487); create restore-point; run backup op; release lock. Schedule setting is read-only here and NOT mutated.
steps.6_event_receipt_observable: emit backup.performed receipt { backup_ref, restore_point_ref, scope, byte_size }; ObservableOperation shows truthful phases (snapshot/transfer/verify) including lock-wait, never fake liveness
steps.7_ui_projection: last-backup status badge updates with timestamp + backup_ref; Backup & Restore manager last-run card refreshes; schedule toggle unchanged; ReceiptLink attached to the action
steps.8_usage_diagnostic: backup op attributed to backup.write usage/diagnostic bucket; backup_ref + restore_point_ref joinable to storage receipts
steps.9_recovery_deeplink: deep link Open receipt -> ReceiptLink; Open backup manager -> cmd.storage.backup.open; rollback via restore_point_ref if scope was settings

traces.must_not: Must not mutate the backup schedule setting; must not show fake progress while waiting on the canonical-store lock; must not skip restore-point for settings scope

traces.flow: Import preview -> apply -> rollback (restore point + atomic + receipt)
traces.distinguishes: preview (read) vs apply (atomic mutate, restore-point first) vs rollback (revert to snapshot); legacy-key migration + validation gates

steps.1_ui_source: Settings Lifecycle landmark -> Import button -> conflict preview panel -> Apply button -> (on failure/regret) Rollback button
steps.2_command: preview: cmd.settings.import.preview { bundle_ref, mode: 'merge'|'replace' }; apply: cmd.settings.import.apply { bundle_ref, mode, preview_token, restore_point_ref }; rollback: cmd.settings.import.rollback { restore_point_ref }
steps.3_canonical_owner: Plans/Commands_System.md (settings lifecycle) + Plans/settings_inventory.json (legacy-key migration map) + Plans/storage-plan.md (restore-point storage)
steps.4_validation_permission: preview: settings.read; apply: settings.write + restore_point must exist + validation must pass + legacy-key migration must resolve; rollback: settings.write + restore_point not expired
steps.5_state_op: apply: atomic under canonical-store lock -> restore-point created BEFORE any mutation -> legacy-key migration -> validate -> apply all-or-nothing -> commit; rollback: atomic restore from restore-point snapshot
steps.6_event_receipt_observable: preview: no event (read). apply: emit settings.imported { restore_point_ref, applied_count, conflict_resolutions, source disclosure }. rollback: emit settings.rolled_back { restore_point_ref }. ObservableOperation shows phase for apply (migrate/validate/write/commit).
steps.7_ui_projection: preview panel shows 3-way conflicts with resolution hints; after apply, ValueSourceBadge refreshes on affected rows; after rollback, rows return to restore-point values; ReceiptLink on apply + rollback
steps.8_usage_diagnostic: import apply + rollback attributed to settings.write diagnostic bucket; restore_point_ref + bundle_ref joinable
steps.9_recovery_deeplink: rollback deep link from the apply receipt; Open restore point -> ReceiptLink; SettingsDestination deep link to first conflicted setting

traces.must_not: Apply must not run without a restore-point; rollback must not be silently disabled; apply must be atomic (no partial state on mid-apply failure)

traces.distinguishes: ONE-TIME transactional copy across ~10 categories; destination INDEPENDENT after; NOT universal inheritance; no ongoing link created

steps.1_ui_source: Settings Lifecycle landmark -> Copy Settings From -> source project picker -> category multi-select (~10) -> diff preview -> Copy button
steps.2_command: preview: cmd.settings.copy_from_project.preview { source_project_id, categories: [...] }; apply: cmd.settings.copy_from_project.apply { source_project_id, categories, preview_token, restore_point_ref }
steps.3_canonical_owner: Plans/Commands_System.md (settings lifecycle transactional copy) + Plans/settings_inventory.json (category enumeration source)
steps.4_validation_permission: preview: settings.read + project.read; apply: settings.write + restore_point exists + categories valid + source project readable
steps.5_state_op: apply: atomic under canonical-store lock -> restore-point created -> copy selected categories atomically -> commit. NO inheritance/parent-child link is written; destination rows are plain owned values after.
steps.6_event_receipt_observable: apply: emit settings.copied_from_project { source_project_id, categories, restore_point_ref, source disclosure }. ObservableOperation shows per-category copy phase.
steps.7_ui_projection: diff preview shows source_value vs target_value per setting; after apply, affected rows refresh with ValueSourceBadge=custom (NOT inherited); ReceiptLink on apply. Subsequent source-project changes do NOT propagate (verifiable in fixture).
steps.8_usage_diagnostic: copy attributed to settings.write diagnostic bucket; source_project_id + categories joinable
steps.9_recovery_deeplink: rollback deep link from copy receipt (cmd.settings.import.rollback to restore_point_ref); SettingsDestination to first copied category

traces.must_not: Must not create a parent-child inheritance relationship; must not propagate future source changes; ValueSourceBadge must read 'custom' not 'inherited' after copy

traces.distinguishes: non-destructive compaction (append-only successor records, never rewrite closed seglog) vs deletion; BLOCKED while legal hold active; receipts for preserved set

steps.1_ui_source: Storage & Retention landmark -> Compact action (domain_action), with dry-run option; distinct from Delete Project (irreversible) and Quarantine inspect
steps.4_validation_permission: permission storage.compact; REJECT with legal_hold_active if any managed hold covers the scope; ResourceGovernor admission; lock acquire
steps.5_state_op: acquire aggregate canonical-store lock; compaction rebuilds redb projections/lookup/JSONL mirror/Tantivy index from append-only successor records; canonical EventRecord values retained/migrated, NEVER rewritten in place (storage-plan.md:479); closed seglog segments untouched
steps.6_event_receipt_observable: emit storage.compacted receipt { preserved_set, compaction_receipt_ref, reclaimed_bytes }; ObservableOperation shows phase (scan/rebuild/verify) with lock-wait
steps.7_ui_projection: StorageHealth refreshes (pressure/hold/quarantine badges); reclaimed bytes shown; ReceiptLink attached; last-compaction timestamp updates
steps.8_usage_diagnostic: compaction attributed to storage.compact diagnostic bucket; preserved_set + receipt_ref joinable
steps.9_recovery_deeplink: Open receipt -> ReceiptLink; Inspect holds -> cmd.storage.hold.manage (action='inspect'); Open Storage & Retention landmark

traces.must_not: Must not compact while a legal hold is active; must not rewrite closed seglog segments in place; must not delete durable canonical receipts or canonical state transitions

traces.distinguishes: start container (reuse catalog.docker_container_start) vs switch engine (catalog.docker_context_select) vs host instance start; engine health gate

steps.1_ui_source: Containers & Registries landmark -> container row -> Start button; disabled with reason when engine unhealthy (Podman stopped)
steps.3_canonical_owner: Plans/Containers_Registry_and_Unraid.md (containers owner); engine health owned by shared tool lifecycle (Plans/BinaryLocator_Spec.md)
steps.4_validation_permission: permission container.start; validate engine health (Podman/Docker/kubectl reachable); validate auth/registry creds if pulling; ResourceGovernor admission
steps.5_state_op: engine health probe -> container start op via engine CLI/socket; coalesce duplicate starts
steps.6_event_receipt_observable: emit container.started receipt { container_id, engine, receipt_ref }; ObservableOperation shows start phase; on engine-unhealthy, show reason + SetupFlowLauncher CTA
steps.7_ui_projection: container row status -> running; engine health badge refreshes; ReceiptLink on success; switch-engine offered on failure
steps.8_usage_diagnostic: container start attributed to container.start diagnostic bucket; engine + container_id joinable
steps.9_recovery_deeplink: Open logs -> catalog.docker_container_view_logs; Open docker manager -> catalog.docker_hosts_open; SetupFlowLauncher for engine setup

traces.must_not: Must not bypass the engine health gate; reuses existing catalog id (no new command); must not silently fail on stopped Podman (must show reason + recovery)

traces.distinguishes: long non-blocking phased rebuild vs enable/disable (setting) vs clear cache; CancellationToken honored on disable; failures surfaced not hidden

steps.1_ui_source: Project Search Index landmark -> Rebuild button; distinct from enable toggle (web.index.enable) and clear cache (web.index.evict-cache)
steps.4_validation_permission: permission search.index.rebuild; validate index enabled (web.index.enable); honor exclusions + file-size + symlink policy; ResourceGovernor admission
steps.5_state_op: non-blocking phased builder; on disable mid-build, cancel via CancellationToken, remove partial generation state, on re-enable start fresh (FinalGUISpec.md:963); failures (oversize/symlink-loop/permission) collected per-file
steps.6_event_receipt_observable: emit search_index.rebuilt receipt { phases, failure_count, index_state }; ObservableOperation shows phase + per-file progress; failures list openable; NOT fake liveness
steps.7_ui_projection: index status badge: indexing/stale/ready/fallback; failure count surfaced; progress truthful; on completion, index_state reflects degraded-but-usable if failures > 0
steps.8_usage_diagnostic: rebuild attributed to search.index.rebuild diagnostic bucket; failure_count + project_id joinable
steps.9_recovery_deeplink: Open failures -> ResourceDetail with per-file failure list; Clear cache -> catalog.search_evict_remote_cache; SettingsDestination to exclusions

traces.must_not: Must not block the whole Settings workspace; must not hide failures; must honor CancellationToken on disable; must not show fake progress

traces.distinguishes: dry-run (no mutation, worktree safety + evidence floor) vs destructive clean; receipts retained; distinct from runtime artifact cleanup and storage compaction

steps.1_ui_source: Workspace Cleanup landmark -> Clean Workspace -> dry-run report -> approve -> Clean; distinct from branching.worktrees.clean-workspace-now (which becomes dry-run-first)
steps.2_command: dry_run: cmd.cleanup.dry_run { scope: 'worktree'|'workspace', include_ignored }; clean: cmd.cleanup.clean { dry_run_token, scope, evidence_retention_floor_days }
steps.3_canonical_owner: Plans/WorktreeGitImprovement.md (worktree cleanup) + Plans/storage-plan.md (bounded collections + evidence retention)
steps.4_validation_permission: dry_run: cleanup.read; clean: cleanup.write + dry_run_token valid + not expired; worktree-in-use check; evidence_retention_floor enforced (branching.worktrees.evidence-retention-days)
steps.5_state_op: dry_run: read-only scan -> classify removable vs protected (worktree in use) vs evidence-retained (above floor). clean: under canonical-store lock -> remove removable set -> preserve evidence-retained set -> commit. NO removal below evidence floor.
steps.6_event_receipt_observable: dry_run: no event (read). clean: emit cleanup.performed receipt { dry_run_ref, removed_count, evidence_retained_count, evidence_retention_floor, receipt_ref }; ObservableOperation shows phase (scan/remove/verify)
steps.7_ui_projection: dry-run report lists removable/protected/retained with reason_per_item; after clean, StorageHealth/disk projection refreshes; ReceiptLink on clean
steps.8_usage_diagnostic: cleanup attributed to cleanup.write diagnostic bucket; dry_run_ref + receipt_ref + evidence_retention_floor joinable
steps.9_recovery_deeplink: Open receipt -> ReceiptLink; restore from backup if a needed artifact was removed; SettingsDestination to evidence-retention setting

traces.must_not: Must not destroy evidence below the evidence-retention floor; must not skip dry-run for destructive cleanup; must not co-mingle with runtime artifact cleanup or storage compaction

coverage_assertion: All 7 required flows traced end-to-end through the 9-step rule. No concept-only local state. Action/setting/status/manager distinctions preserved per flow. Reuse of existing catalog ids flagged; new candidate ids marked provisional.
shared_invariants: Every long op projects through ObservableOperation with truthful phases (no fake liveness); lock-wait is a visible phase.
Permission gates precede state mutation; ResourceGovernor admission precedes heavy ops.
Usage/diagnostic attribution is joinable via canonical refs (restore_point_ref, receipt_ref, backup_ref, artifact_id).
Deep links land on a river landmark and scroll (SettingsDestination), never a detached panel.
